title: Job Descriptions & Responsibilities
completion_message: ¡Gran trabajo! Ahora puedes describir responsabilidades laborales como un verdadero profesional.

parts.visual: Frases clave: 'I am responsible for...' (Soy responsable de...), 'I am in charge of...' (Estoy a cargo de...). ATENCIÓN: Después de 'for' y 'of' usamos el verbo con -ING. Ej: I am responsible for managing the team. I am in charge of hiring new staff.
parts.audio: Key phrases: I am responsible for, and I am in charge of. ATTENTION: After the prepositions 'for' and 'of', we use the I-N-G form of the verb. For example: I am responsible for managing the team. I am in charge of hiring new staff.

parts.visual: Más frases: 'My duties include...' (Mis tareas incluyen... + -ING). 'I report to the CEO' (Le reporto al CEO). 'I manage a team of 5 people' (Manejo/Dirijo un equipo de 5 personas).
parts.audio: More phrases: My duties include... plus an I-N-G verb. I report to the CEO. I manage a team of 5 people.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta de describir tu trabajo.

questions.question: I am responsible ____ training the new employees.
I am in charge ____ the marketing department.
questions.explanation: La expresión es 'in charge of' (a cargo de).

questions.question: I am responsible for ____ the team. (Dirigir/Gestionar).
questions.explanation: Después de la preposición 'for', el verbo debe ir con -ing: managing.

questions.question: She is in charge of ____ new staff. (Contratar).
questions.explanation: Después de la preposición 'of', el verbo va con -ing: hiring.

questions.question: My duties ____ organizing the meetings. (Incluyen).
questions.explanation: Duties (mis deberes/tareas) es plural, así que el verbo es 'include' (sin 's').

questions.question: My job ____ calling clients every morning. (Involucra/Implica).
Who do you ____ to? (¿A quién le reportas?).
questions.explanation: Report to = reportarle a alguien (quién es tu jefe).

questions.question: He deals ____ customer complaints. (Se encarga de / Trata con).
questions.explanation: Deal with = lidiar con / encargarse de.

questions.question: I am responsible for ____ the budget. (Aprobar).
She is in charge of ____ software. (Desarrollar).
My role ____ supporting the IT manager. (Es).
questions.explanation: My role is = mi rol es...

questions.question: As a project manager, I ____ the team's progress. (Superviso).
I am ____ for designing the new website. (Responsable).
I am in ____ of the logistics department. (A cargo).
My duties include ____ data. (Analizar).
questions.explanation: Después de 'include' a menudo usamos gerundio.

questions.question: I make sure that everything ____ smoothly. (Funcione/Marche).
questions.explanation: Run smoothly = funcionar sin problemas. Everything (It) lleva 's': runs.

questions.question: I am in ____ of the team. (A cargo)
I am responsible for ____ the budget. (manage - en gerundio)
I am in charge of ____ staff. (hire - en gerundio)

pairs.target: Asegurarme de que todo marche bien

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I am responsible for managing the team.
options: I am responsible for managing the team.
I am responsible for manage the team.
I am in charge for managing the team.
She is responsible for managing the team.
questions.correct_answer: I am responsible for managing the team.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: She is in charge of hiring new staff.
options: She is in charge of hiring new staff.
He is in charge of hiring new staff.
She is in charge for hiring new staff.
She is in charge of hire new staff.
questions.correct_answer: She is in charge of hiring new staff.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: My duties include organizing the meetings.
options: My duties include organizing the meetings.
My job includes organizing the meetings.
My duties include organize the meetings.
My duties are organizing the meetings.
questions.correct_answer: My duties include organizing the meetings.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I report to the Sales Director.
options: I report to the Sales Director.
I report for the Sales Director.
He reports to the Sales Director.
questions.correct_answer: I report to the Sales Director.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I manage a team of ten people.
options: I manage a team of ten people.
I manage a team of five people.
He manages a team of ten people.
I manage a team with ten people.
questions.correct_answer: I manage a team of ten people.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I coordinate with the other departments.
options: I coordinate with the other departments.
I coordinate for the other departments.
She coordinates with the other departments.
questions.correct_answer: I coordinate with the other departments.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I make sure everything runs smoothly.
options: I make sure everything runs smoothly.
I make sure that everything runs smoothly.
He makes sure everything runs smoothly.
I make sure everything runs well.
questions.correct_answer: I make sure everything runs smoothly.
